# Perception (area `perception`)

Watching what happens on the Mac (apps, notifications, clipboard, typed text) and turning it into facts; notices are paused.

Active decisions here. Run `tools/kb/run kb show <file>` for the ones governing one file, their tests and open work; never reword an owner decision (supersede it).

- **SENSE-1** (owner): Accessibility events stay recorded. FERB knows the data exists and reads it when it needs to (trail.query); it is not pushed into prompts. These rows are kept 7 days.
- **SENSE-2** (owner): The code of Jev, decide, perception batches and attention stays but is switched off. While paused, nothing in them runs.
- **SENSE-3** (agent): `[jev] on` is the one switch, default false. While off: no decider is built (no Keychain read, no request at start), trail tagging is a no-op, no batcher work, no decisions or receipts, no shadow checks, no attention check. On but refused by Jev (HTTP 401/402/403) behaves the same.
- **SENSE-4** (agent): The hourly pass deletes accessibility rows older than 7 days whether or not their day was summarized, 200 rows a transaction (retention.BATCH).
- **SENSE-5** (agent): A browser's accessibility events keep no window title. Text typed or copied in a browser carries its page's host and incognito flag from the last tab observation, so the incognito and excluded-domain rules drop it; text typed or copied in a browser page FERB hasn't seen is not recorded (it can't be checked).
- **SENSE-6** (owner): An upgrade never turns Jev on: a stored Jev key alone doesn't enable it; only `[jev] on` does.
- **SENSE-201** (agent): MacPresence: out of use while the Mac sleeps, its displays sleep, the screen is locked or the login session is switched away (workspace and distributed notifications on FERB's own run-loop thread, plus a 5 s read of session lock/console state and display sleep). Back = none of those holds after one did, journaled `mac.back_in_use`. A daemon start in a new login session is a return ("login"), unless locked then; a start in the same session (update, crash) isn't. Pause FERB: unknown, counted as present.
- **SENSE-400** (agent): A transcription may take `LIMIT_S` (60 s) plus `PER_AUDIO_S` (2 s) for each second of captured sound; past it the ask is cancelled, the lease deleted (the hearing process exits) and the tool says hearing is unavailable. The status probe has the 60 s base. A listen's length stays the model's choice (no cap on `seconds`). Redaction alignment runs in a worker thread, off the event loop.
- **SENSE-401** (owner): Typed text is recorded per field with its content; secure fields, Secure Input, password fields (shown ones too) and terminal apps are never captured; there is no digit-shape OTP rule; typed and clipboard text are kept 7 days.
- **SENSE-402** (owner): When perception returns: FERB only offers (nothing done until the owner presses Do it), Jev is a switch, no limit on approaches, a daily brief, Mail and Calendar as sources.
- **SENSE-403** (agent): Perception applies the owner's exclusions before anything is written, published or tagged; redacts titles, URLs and captured text before storing them; never reads accessibility values or concealed or transient clipboard contents; keeps rows append-only with an actor; and a pause stops every watcher and records nothing.
- **SENSE-404** (agent): The background clipboard watcher reads pasteboard contents only when macOS allows it without asking (macOS 15.4+ accessBehavior); otherwise it records the access state once and reads nothing.
- **SENSE-405** (agent): The keyboard-activity tap starts only once Input Monitoring is granted, the notification watcher reads nothing until Full Disk Access is on, and a watcher that fails tries again later instead of stopping until a restart.
- **SENSE-406** (agent): Sense checks the owner-input tap at start and every 30 s (`tap_recheck_s`, as the notification watcher rechecks Full Disk Access) and starts it once Input Monitoring is granted; a tap whose grant went is stopped. Each change is journaled once (`owner_input.unavailable` with why, or `owner_input.started`) and shown by `sense.status`/`ferb doctor`. While the tap isn't running FERB counts the owner as using the Mac: `owner_active` true, `available` false, so no foreground input. A tab sound change recorded meanwhile carries `owner_input_monitored: false`.
- **SENSE-407** (agent): `daemon.started` keeps a 16-hex digest of the login session's id under `mac_login` (no secret: it only tells one session from another). A start is a new login session (SENSE-201's "login" return) when its stored digest differs from the previous start's as stored; a previous start without `mac_login` (an older build) or a session that can't be read is no return; the first start ever is one.
- **SENSE-408** (owner): trail.query takes optional since and until (ISO dates or date-times; the clock's zone, the Mac's, when none is named; a bare date as an end covers its whole day; the end is excluded). since replaces since_hours, which keeps working when since is absent. A malformed value is the caller's error before anything is read.
- **SENSE-409** (agent): The watchers' Accessibility elements (ferb-sense Ax::system and Ax::app, which every focused-app, window-title and focused-field read goes through) exist only while AXIsProcessTrusted (a preflight that never prompts) says FERB is trusted, read at most every 2 s; untrusted, they read nothing, as an unreadable element already did. Setup's own request and the Mac tools at a task's first use are unchanged.
